default_authority.principle: COVID delay deductible for the entire period from original trial date to rescheduled trial end, without requiring an articulable link between each sub-period and specific pandemic events. More generous deduction than Ontario's articulable-link standard.

notes: Alberta standard is more generous than Ontario. When jurisdiction = AB and COVID sub-type selected, engine applies Boyko broad deduction but flags as Tier 3. Boyko is a provincial court decision; appellate confirmation pending. Michael to assess reliability of Boyko as precedent.
